verdicts.title: Legende, Op. 46
verdicts.note: Exists: Legende for violin and orchestra, Op. 46 (1900), on cpo 777 114-2 (Bielow); IMSLP works table lists it as violin & orchestra only (no scan found), spelled 'Legende'. Key sources conflict (Wikipedia: B major; Radio Swiss Classic and the cpo track list: B-flat major), so I left the key out. No piano-only or Peters edition found; accompaniment set to the house 'Orchestra (piano reduction)'.
